01 / FACIAL AESTHETICS
ORIGINAL DESIGN / BILATERAL IMPLANTS

CONTOUR. BALANCE. INDIVIDUALITY.

A considered contour.
A personal fit.

Facial design is about the relationship between structure and identity.

Patient-specific mandibular angle implants are developed around the individual bone surface and the intended facial contour. This bilateral design brings the implant and anatomy into one coherent planning conversation.

04 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE PRECISION

Technical by training.
Considered by nature.

I’m Erfan Mohiti, a maxillofacial prosthesis designer at Farin Roshaan.

Across more than 400 patient cases, my work has connected digital planning with the demands of implant design, surgical guides and production. My focus is simple: understand the individual, then design with intention.
